target_caveat: Trained and evaluated against GloFAS v4 reanalysis - a MODELLED product, not observed river data. Observed CWC gauge data will replace this when access is granted. Predictions are modelled discharge, never 'river levels'.

q_today_m3s.source: GloFAS v4 consolidated reanalysis via Open-Meteo Flood API (model reanalysis, NOT a gauge reading)

catchment_rain_24h_mm.source: Open-Meteo forecast product past hours (model analysis), mean of 4 katakhal catchment cells (CATCHMENT.md)

catchment_rain_48h_mm.source: Open-Meteo forecast product past hours (model analysis), mean of 4 katakhal catchment cells (CATCHMENT.md)

threshold_m3s.source: 90th percentile of 2015-2025 monsoon GloFAS reanalysis (NOT an official danger level)

q_m3s.source: JalDrishti model v0 for katakhal - shipped: B1_persistence, fitted on 2015-2025 GloFAS reanalysis (docs/MODEL-CARD-katakhal-v0.md); modelled discharge, NOT observed river levels

p_exceed_threshold.source: JalDrishti model v0 for katakhal - shipped: B1_persistence, fitted on 2015-2025 GloFAS reanalysis (docs/MODEL-CARD-katakhal-v0.md); modelled discharge, NOT observed river levels - probability from held-out validation residuals

q_m3s.source: JalDrishti model v0 for katakhal - shipped: B1_persistence, fitted on 2015-2025 GloFAS reanalysis (docs/MODEL-CARD-katakhal-v0.md); modelled discharge, NOT observed river levels

p_exceed_threshold.source: JalDrishti model v0 for katakhal - shipped: B1_persistence, fitted on 2015-2025 GloFAS reanalysis (docs/MODEL-CARD-katakhal-v0.md); modelled discharge, NOT observed river levels - probability from held-out validation residuals

colour.source: decision rule on model v0 output: P(exceed) >= 0.5 RED, >= 0.2 YELLOW, else GREEN (documented cutoffs, arbitrary)

basis_plain: A tested river model expects unusually high water on the Katakhal / Dhaleswari near here by tomorrow.
